content: Human-labeling session — lh-recovery-after-mid-game-loss:medium seed 1. Objective: Commander, you hold a forward Soviet base at mid-map — Construction Yard, Ore Refinery, Power Plant, an Ore Truck and two rifle defenders, with a small ore patch beside it. You also have a parked Mobile Construction Vehicle and a second Power Plant at a deep-west safe zone. A heavy enemy ground rush — six rifles and two rocket soldiers — is closing from the east; reinforcement waves keep arriving through the run, so the forward region will stay hostile. Cash: $1600. Win bar: a Construction Yard AND an Ore Refinery, both standing inside the deep-west disc (radius 8 around the safe zone), AND at least one of your units alive, within about fifty turns. Total loss of every Construction Yard you own is an immediate fail.
